name: CITIES Dashboard
description: A front-end dashboard delivering air-quality insights to schools across Monroe, Louisiana.
longDescription: Built a dashboard front end delivering air-quality insights to 20K+ students across schools in Monroe, Louisiana. Automated builds and deployment with GitHub Actions, reducing release time by approximately 30%.

name: Stock Price Prediction (AI4ALL)
description: A financial NLP pipeline classifying stock movements from news headlines and market data.
longDescription: Built a financial NLP pipeline processing 322K headlines and 20M stock records, using FinBERT sentiment features to classify stock movements. Engineered a Competitive Pressure Index measuring negative-news surges relative to baseline coverage; trained a Random Forest with 5-fold cross-validation, achieving 54% accuracy and outperforming Logistic Regression.
